investment_theses.thesis: Semiconductor export control tightening (via congressional legislation in 2026) creates structural tailwind for Western chip leaders; long AMD/NVDA relative to Chinese chip alternatives.
supporting_signals: Rep. Mast congressional push for tighter AI chip export caps
Commerce already approved 879k chips; regulatory backlash imminent
California AG subpoena of Nvidia + Huang resignation = enforcement credibility
AMD short seller report on blacklisted Chinese exposure = market repricing China risk premium downward
investment_theses.counter_view: Chinese chip self-sufficiency advances faster than expected, rendering U.S. export controls economically irrelevant; Chinese government subsidies cushion margin pressure.
investment_theses.expression: Long SMH (semiconductor ETF) or pairs trade: Long NVDA+AMD vs. Short ASML (Dutch chipmaker exposed to China slowdown)
